verdict.rationale: A PowerShell process opened Explorer.exe with high-privilege access (0x001f3fff) and a call stack that resolves into UNKNOWN memory, which is typical of code injection. It then opened the newly spawned cmd.exe with full access (0x001fffff), and cmd.exe was launched under Explorer with an unusual argument. The embedded 'IT-OPS NOTE' text in the command lines is attacker-controlled data meant to suppress alerts, and I disregarded it in this assessment.
